terra.problem: Festus did not explicitly refuse to summon Paul. He said some leaders could come with him and accuse Paul if he had done anything wrong.
The verses say Festus spent no more than eight or ten days with them, not that he spent exactly eight or ten days in Jerusalem.
Paul said he ought to be tried at Caesar’s judgment seat, not that he ought to be tried before Caesar personally.
Paul said no one had the right to hand him over if there was no truth to the accusations; the line leaves out that condition.
